name: Nestra P1.2 — conservative replay and grounded scenarios

curation.method: deterministic source-quality selection; unit-test-confirmed code generation preferred; review comments stripped of author discussion; failed or empty completions excluded; same-family examples not reused across splits

labels.p1_replay: previously seen by P1; rehearsal, not new learning
labels.new_scenario: newly authored, source-grounded scenario; independent human review still pending

curation.not_included: Private evaluation task text and model failures were not inserted as training targets

known_limitations: 961/1000 records are replay drawn from sources already used by P1; this is not a thousand novel examples.
39 new scenarios were checked for structural rules only and still need independent editorial review for answer quality.
Source verification of third-party datasets does not establish that every completion is semantically correct or useful.
Existing corpus leakage gates are inherited; the selected P1.2 corpus must pass the repository validator and a fresh semantic holdout audit before training.
No candidate has been trained or evaluated from this corpus.
